desc: go along, defeated (19.30.8, W31d): b defeated in stag0201 when a goes in: no notice while b is defeated (it shows when b lives again); c, the last living member of b's stage group, goes along: b is taken along (the side rule), no game over; a test hook defeats c between the stamp and the GO's step: the GO does nothing on every engine, "Couldn't go along: you were defeated." NEEDS go_test_hooks: a deterministic defeat at a sealed tick (an event every engine of the stage group applies), not built in round I1b's go lane; the side rule and the GO doing nothing for a defeated slot are held by dw4_online_session_tests (go_along_session) and the engine's exit_leavers
